mahanaicoach-google-maps-scraper-kit-goo.description: Google Maps scraper for lead generation. Turns a business type and a place into a clean CSV of local businesses by driving the kit's own Google Maps engine, running locally (with Python and a headless Chrome, or in Docker) as a REST API on localhost:8080. Returns 8 lead fields by default (name, phone, email, website, category, address, rating and review count), plus social profiles by default (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, X; `--no-socials` skips them), row filters such as businesses without a website, or all 36 raw fields.
